# IHH Plans To Raise Fortis Stake To 51% By 2030, Sees RM5.8 Billion Capital Injection
IHH Healthcare Bhd plans to gradually increase its stake in India’s Fortis Healthcare Ltd to 51% from 31.17% by 2030, potentially requiring about RM5.8 billion in capital over the next four years, according to CIMB Securities.
